- baseHue = mazeHash % 360 (BigInt) on TS, seed % 360 on Sol.

by MazeRenderer.sol. They MUST agree byte-for-byte with the TS recipe — this

fields.name: wall
fields.doc: Dark, moderately saturated. Stays legible against any bg.

fields.name: textBg

fields.name: zkBg
